The '''Coronet City Waste Disposal Center''',<ref name="Suns of Fortune">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref>, also known as '''The Pit''', was a large junkyard that was located on the outskirts of [[Blue Sector/Legends|Blue Sector]], a crime-ridden region of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. A rumor that circulated among the residents of Blue Sector claimed that more "organic drop-offs" were disposed of in The Pit than actual manufactured waste.
